title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - EnergyMix
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/EnergyMix. Details the composition of energy sources in a given mix.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnergyMix'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

attainmentDate.description: Property. Date for which this energy mix has been attained (if in the past) or is forecast to be attained (if in the future).

renewableEnergy.description: Property. Percentage of renewable energy in the energy mix.

hourlyCarbonFreeEnergy.description: Property. Percentage of hourly carbon-free energy in the energy mix.
